prompt: You are about to register a new reasoning-capable OpenAI model in the default OpenAI plugin. Which OpenAI API endpoint does the project currently use by default for reasoning-capable OpenAI models, what did that replace, how can a user fall back to the older path for a single prompt, and what happened to the older model classes? Name the docs and source files that state this decision.

points: Responses API for most reasoning models

gold_citations.quote: Most reasoning-capable OpenAI models now use the `/v1/responses` endpoint by default, enabling interleaved reasoning across tool calls.
use the Responses API by default
# GPT-5.5 — routes through the Responses API by default; pass
Tests for the /v1/responses code path in the default OpenAI plugin.
Most reasoning-capable OpenAI models now use the [`/v1/responses`](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/responses/overview) endpoint instead of `/v1/chat/completions`.
Use `-o chat_completions 1` to fall back to the older `/v1/chat/completions` code path for any of these models.
The existing `Chat` and `AsyncChat` classes are unchanged so other plugins that import them keep working.
The existing Chat Completions classes remain available, and `-o chat_completions 1` selects that older path for an individual prompt.
